item: data-drive watchdog: a restart thread that cannot start no longer strands the page on 'restarting' for ever, and a pause thread that cannot start no longer raises into the caller
summary: Measured with a threading shim whose named thread's start() raises: tick moved the phase to 'restarting' before the restart thread started; the failure left it there (still 'restarting' after 300 s, restart never called). Now the phase and deadline are put back, the next tick retries, and the 'reconnected' incident is written once (_reconnect_recorded). A failed pause-thread start in _trigger is logged and no longer escapes into poke()/tick(). Exception only (R393/R395). Not field-observed.
